files_created.purpose: URL normalizer boundary conditions: trailing slashes, .git suffix, mixed case, invalid URLs, non-canonical schemes, pull-number boundaries.
Enqueue idempotency: concurrent calls, claimed/succeeded/dead state transitions, input validation (missing prUrl/action/payload), DB error propagation, bulk enqueue.
Backoff/jitter: exponential doubling across attempts=0..N, jitter distribution over 1000 samples, non-determinism, exhaustion boundary (maxAttempts=1, maxAttempts=N).
CAS safety on applySettle (status='claimed'), workerId validation (SQL injection guard, length cap), batchSize validation, claim SQL parameterization, reclaim SQL parameterization.
Webhook payload robustness: huge payload, prototype pollution, invalid JSON, schema-invalid payloads (empty html_url, wrong types); signature/replay attacks; duplicate-delivery suppression.

Admin DLQ endpoint boundary/failure paths: Zod clamping/rejection (limit=0, limit=-1, limit=10000, fractional, offset=-1, status enum), role discrimination (STUDENT/TEACHER/INTERN/GUARDIAN), unauthenticated → UNAUTHORIZED, malformed UUID rejection, error-code discrimination (UNAUTHORIZED vs FORBIDDEN vs BAD_REQUEST).

files_modified.reason: Two real bugs found and fixed by adversarial probes.

bugfixes.issue: Regex /github\.com\/.../ is unanchored, so URLs like 'ftp://github.com/org/repo/pull/1' or 'https://github.corp.example.com/org/repo/pull/1' could match (substring) or partially capture 'pull/1.5' as 'pull/1'. Zero PR number also accepted.
bugfixes.fix: Anchored the regex with ^https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?github\.com\/ and a trailing delimiter class (?=$|[/?#]); additionally reject pullNumber <= 0.

bugfixes.issue: Exhaustion check `if (job.attempts >= job.maxAttempts)` is off-by-one. With maxAttempts=1, the first failure schedules a retry instead of going to dead; spec semantics say 'after max_attempts failed attempts, the job goes dead'.
bugfixes.fix: Changed comparison to `if (job.attempts + 1 >= job.maxAttempts)` so the post-increment count is what gets compared against the cap.

anti_pattern_defenses_applied.A3_labeled_integer_counts: All integer assertions use labeled arguments to expect(...). No bare regex /\d+/ matches.
anti_pattern_defenses_applied.A4_vacuous_pass: Every test asserts a specific observable (thrown error, mock call count, returned value). No 'no exception' alone.
anti_pattern_defenses_applied.A7_over_broad_filter: Assertions use exact equality, labeled integers, and explicit regex with /i case-insensitive flag where appropriate. No substring matches that could swallow regressions.
anti_pattern_defenses_applied.A5_false_claim: All 'the source does X' claims are verified by source-grep tests (e.g., the applySettle CAS pattern test).

notes: Adversarial probes intentionally covered boundary cases the happy-path tests miss: prototype pollution, SQL metacharacter injection via workerId, off-by-one in exhaustion comparison, unanchored regex substring matches.

Two real bugs were found and fixed: (1) normalizePrKey regex accepted non-HTTP schemes and fractional PR numbers; (2) settleJob exhaustion check was off-by-one for maxAttempts=1. Both fixes are minimal and preserve the existing happy-path contract (phase-3-retry-backoff, phase-3-exhaust-to-dead still pass).

The test for 'duplicate delivery does NOT cause a second comment' pins the contract from spec FR-2 (idempotent enqueue); the in-process `processedDeliveryIds` Set short-circuits before enqueueReviewJob is called.

The applySettle CAS pattern is verified via source-grep (not live SQL introspection) because Drizzle's `eq()` returns a SQL chunk whose toQuery() requires the full dialect context, which is fragile to mock. The source-grep assertion is the same style used by phase-3-claim-skip-locked.test.ts for the FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED check.
The adversarial-webhook-flow.test.ts uses the REAL verifyWebhookSignature from github-client.ts (not a mock) so the HMAC + replay-attack paths are exercised end-to-end.
All new tests are deterministic except the jitter randomness test (which deliberately asserts non-determinism with 10 trials).
Adversarial tests do not modify any existing test files.
